shortDescription: Shares of HCLTech NSE:HCLTECH rose 4% in early trade on Tuesday after brokerages pointed to a stronger-than-expected quarterly margin performance, robust deal bookings and growing revenue from advanced AI services, offsetting concerns over weaker software sales.
